dedupe_keys.name: arret de bus des pyrenees atlantiques

description: Arrêt de bus des Pyrénées Atlantiques is a dataset listed in Data64 open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Point d'accès national. Agrégat des différents jeux de données présents sur le point d'accès national présentant les arrêts de bus sur le territoire des Pyrénées Atlantiques ainsi que certaines lignes interdépartementales. Coverage: Pyrénées-Atlantiques. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are bus, arrêt, transports, deplacement, vivre dans le 64. The portal shows 4,648 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-le64-fr-portal.
